prompt_md: Three switches outside a closed room; one works an old-fashioned bulb inside. Flip them all you like. How few times must you enter the room to know which switch it is?
prompt_short: 3 switches, 1 bulb in a closed room. Fewest visits to know which switch?
hint_md: A bulb gives off more than light.
explain_intuition_md: Turn switch 1 on for a few minutes, turn it off, then turn switch 2 on and walk in. Lit means switch 2. Dark but warm means switch 1. Dark and cold means switch 3.
explain_math_md: No math: each switch leaves a different trace (light, heat, or neither), so $1$ visit tells all $3$ apart.
